Honey Buffalo Chicken Mac & Cheese

Creamy high-protein macaroni with crispy honey-buffalo chicken. The sauce blends cottage cheese, cream cheese and cheddar into a smooth, satisfying meal-prep favorite.

Prep
Not listed
Cook
Not listed
Total
30 min
Difficulty
Not listed
Ingredients
8

Ingredients

  • 700 g diced chicken breast, seasoned with salt, smoked paprika, garlic powder and onion powder
  • 350 g low-fat cottage cheese
  • 65 g low-fat cream cheese, or 4 light cheese wedges
  • 35 g cheddar, grated
  • 80 ml low-fat milk
  • 20 ml Frank’s Buffalo hot sauce, plus 1 tbsp for the chicken
  • 320 g dry protein macaroni or elbow pasta
  • 1 tbsp honey

Amounts are scaled from 4 original servings. Season to taste.

Instructions

  1. Season the chicken with salt, smoked paprika, garlic powder and onion powder.
  2. Blend cottage cheese, cream cheese, cheddar, milk and 20 ml hot sauce for about 2 minutes, until smooth.
  3. Cook the pasta according to the package directions. Drain, reserving a splash of pasta water.
  4. Cook chicken in a nonstick skillet over medium heat for 8–10 minutes, turning until golden and cooked through to 165°F (74°C).
  5. Turn off the heat. Stir honey and 1 tbsp Buffalo sauce through the chicken.
  6. Toss pasta with the cheese sauce. Loosen with a splash of pasta water if needed, then divide into four portions and top with chicken.

Cook times may vary when changing batch size.
